crossRefs.note: He said to them, “You men of Israel, be careful concerning these men, what you are about to do.
If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place…
When our enemies heard that it was known to us, and God had brought their counsel to nothing, all of us returned to the…
He frustrates the plans of the crafty, So that their hands can’t perform their enterprise.
Yahweh brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.
The counsel of Yahweh stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.
Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have plotted evil against you, saying,
Make an uproar, you peoples, and be broken in pieces! Listen, all you from far countries: dress for battle, and be…
Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand, for God is with us.”
that I will break the Assyrian in my land, and tread him under foot on my mountains. Then his yoke will leave them, and…
Who is he who says, and it comes to pass, when the Lord doesn’t command it?
But he answered, “Every plant which my heavenly Father didn’t plant will be uprooted.
For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;
For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He has taken the wise in their craftiness.”

translations.web: Now I tell you, withdraw from these men, and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown.
translations.bsb: So in the present case I advise you: Leave these men alone. Let them go! For if their purpose or endeavor is of human origin, it will fail.
translations.kjv: And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought:
